findings: action_suffix covers every RuntimeAction constructor; only LOG0 appends and all other represented actions preserve logs. Pure family inversion uses actual successful action computation, not an assumed frame.

trace_suffix derives each Action and next stack/alignment from the same checked Step and propagates them. Concatenation retains ordered per-step suffixes with entry logs once, no assumed final suffix or matching source list.
success_contribution uses the derived exact prefix equation to discharge success_logs; List.drop removes only incoming prefix length.
terminal_logs covers STOP/RETURN/REVERT successful handler computations including exact output result; log equality ignores only unrelated terminal PC.

terminal_contribution extracts same actual eval prefix/finalWarm/terminal result, derives suffix and terminal preservation, and selects success settlement only from result.halt != reverted. No arbitrary second trace or supplied terminal warmth.
open_boundaries: The existential suffix is derived, but this theorem does not publish a separate opcode-indexed occurrence identity or prove source-global unique log provenance.
Initial replay prefix must still be bound to actual source parent logs; source child initial empty logs and transfer LOG3 projection remain separate context producers.
Successful local contribution is not globally committed; ancestor rollback can discard it.
Stack bound/alignment and destination context are explicit local inputs; source/Python and canonical history extraction remain open.
